d:
Does stress often show up right in your stomach? Start your day by calming your second brain.
In this 8-minute morning practice, we tap into the powerful gut-brain connection to ease stress-related digestive tension, quiet an overactive nervous system, and promote natural healing from within.
Through gentle diaphragmatic breathing (which physically massages your internal organs), a soothing "warm light" visualisation, and grounding affirmations, you will release the knots of tension you hold in your core.
Find a comfortable seat, settle in, and invite ease and harmony back into your centre.
